description: The issuer vouches for another key: what kinds of record it may issue, in which streams, between which instants, and whether it may vouch for others in turn. `parent` is the endorsement the issuer's own standing comes from; a root has none.

actorPrefixes.description: Who the subject may name as the actor of a record, by prefix. Absent means no narrower than the grant above it.

actsFor.description: A stable identity written as a URI. Syntax is not authentication.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.

kinds.description: The kind paths the subject may issue, each named in full. There is no wildcard: a grant never covers a kind its author did not name.

notAfter.description: RFC 3339 calendar-valid instant with up to nanosecond precision; leap seconds and unknown -00:00 offsets are outside this profile. ordered compares UTC instants, not text.

notBefore.description: RFC 3339 calendar-valid instant with up to nanosecond precision; leap seconds and unknown -00:00 offsets are outside this profile. ordered compares UTC instants, not text.

parent.description: The identity of one signed evidence record.

streamPrefixes.description: Streams the subject may write to, by prefix. Absent means no narrower than the grant above it.
